blurb: Visitors take guided tours above and below decks of the refurbished Lightship Overfalls, learning about its history, restoration, and the role of lightships in American maritime history. The site includes a museum and ship store with maritime artifacts and related merchandise. Group and off-season tours can be arranged by contacting the Director of Tours.
extraNote: Group and off-season tours can be arranged by contacting the Director of Tours · Lightship Overfalls, 219 Pilottown Road, Lewes, Delaware · Lewes Maritime Day through mid-October, with special openings
